description: This file defines the TreeHash class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically within the Glacier service. It implements the creation of a tree hash from streamed data, providing methods to update data, add checksums directly, finalize the hash, and reset the state.

classes.name: TreeHash
classes.description: Encapsulates the creation of a tree hash from streamed data, implementing the HashInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TreeHash with a specified hash algorithm (default 'sha256') and resets its state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Streams data into the hash, buffering and creating checksums when buffer exceeds 1MB.

methods.name: addChecksum
methods.description: Adds a precomputed checksum to the hash, optionally accepting binary form.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation by processing remaining data and checksums, producing the root hash.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the TreeHash object, clearing checksums and buffer.
